description: SINGLE STOREY  REAR AND DOUBLE STOREY SIDE/REAR EXTENSION
decision_conditions: Due to the lack of the adequate set back of the proposed first floor side extension from the front elevation and the proposed roof design of the front porch and its scale, the proposal would result in loss of the characteristic cat-slide roof feature resulting in unacceptable impact on the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the existing street scene, in conflict with Paragraph 135 of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024, Policies D3 of the London Plan 2021, Policy DM10 of the Council's Core Strategy 2012 and Policy Guidance 37 of the Council's Residential Design Supplementary Planning Document 2013.

Due to the existing front building line that is set forward the adjoining property no. 87 and given siting and combined excessive mass and bulk of the proposed front and side extensions and insufficient set back from the common boundary with no. 87, the proposal is considered to appear as a dominant and disproportionate addition to the host dwelling and the surrounding area that would adversely affect the existing street scene and would unbalance the adjoining  linked property no. 2 Minstead Way, in conflict with Paragraph 135 of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024, Policies D3 of the London Plan 2021, Policy DM10 of the Council's Core Strategy 2012 and Policy Guidance 36 and 38 of the Council's Residential Design Supplementary Planning Document 2013.

Due to excessive mass and bulk of the proposed front and side extension and their siting in relation to the adjoining property no. 87 Amberwood Rise, it is considered that the proposal would appear as overbearing and unneighbourly when viewed from this property. Furthermore, insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that the proposal would pass the "25 Degree Rule" in relation to the window in the side dormer at no. 87 and therefore it would not result in unacceptable loss of daylight in relation to this window. As such, it is considered that the proposal would result in harm to the residential amenities of the occupants at no. 87 amberwood Rise. The proposal is therefore contrary to policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
